title: Employees' Compensation Act, 2010
version: as enacted, gazetted 20 December 2010 (Official Gazette No. 101, Vol. 97, pp. A1283-1328), per search-engine snippets of an earlier NSITF copy; not seen
why_this_instrument: No-fault compensation for workplace injury, occupational disease and death, funded by employer contributions; tells an employee what they or their dependants can claim and how.
not_deposited_reason: Not sourced. The NSITF site was rebuilt as a single-page app; its "Governing Acts" list is served by https://nsitf.gov.ng/api/public/acts, which returned {"acts":[]} on 2026-10-19, and the earlier copy at https://nsitf.gov.ng/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/ECA-2010.pdf returns 404. No other official host was found; unofficial copies (judy.legal and others) were not used.
